title: Numerical investigation of the quantum fluctuations of optical fields transmitted through an atomic medium

scope.reason: Direct PSR mechanism, noise or generation evidence.

findings.claim: Two-polarization propagation includes Zeeman-resolved atomic Langevin diffusion and field spectra.
findings.locator: PDF pp. 3-5, Sec. II, Eqs. (1)-(20); Appendix
findings.model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Reuse atomic operators while deriving a consistent frequency-dependent diffusion matrix.

findings.claim: Velocity classes enter both response and noise propagation.
findings.model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Average the response and noise kernels before propagation; do not average squeezing in dB.

findings.claim: Mean-field depletion is neglected despite propagation of quantum fluctuations.
findings.locator: PDF p. 4, Sec. II, paragraph after Eqs. (5)-(6)
findings.model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Add pump evolution separately when extending to appreciable absorption.
